description: Land Acquisition - Amendment, Karangoda, Elapatha D/S Division, Ratnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that a particular parcel of land is required for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content provides detailed descriptions of the land's location, boundaries, and extent. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related matters, specifically land acquisitions.
